title: Nace.AI, which lets companies build specialized AI models tailored to their business' mission and language, raised a $21.5M seed led by Walden Catalyst (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Nace.AI, which lets companies build specialized AI models tailored to their business' mission and language, raised a $21.5M seed led by Walden Catalyst — Nace.AI, which lets businesses build specialized AI models, raised a $21.5 million seed led by Walden Catalyst, CEO Dos Baha tells Axios Pro exclusively.
